The <b>Hornet Statuette</b> is a [[Items (Silksong)#Consumables|consumable item]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, given to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] as a gift.

== Use ==
Can be used from the inventory to gain {{S|60}}.

== How to Acquire ==
Gifted to [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] by [[Flick the Fixer]] after completing the <i>[[An Icon of Hope]]</i> [[wish]]. Only one can ever be obtained.
